name: Shounen Kantera to Heights Call
original_name: 少年カンテラとハイツコール
source:
Heights call! Heights call!

Kantera, an apprentice employee of the "Yomi Railway" that transports the souls of the dead, is entrusted with the one-day caretaker of "Heights Kagamino" , which is built on the road to Yomi.

"Heights Kagamino" seems to have a service that responds to requests from residents called "Heights Call" ...

[Translated from [url=http://wata-ame.zombie.jp/kandelaar/]official website[/url]]
translation:
呼叫Heights！呼叫Heights！

Kantera是“黄泉铁路”的见习员工。这条铁路负责运送死者的灵魂。她受托临时照看建在通往黄泉之路上的“Heights Kagamino”。

“Heights Kagamino”似乎有一项名为“Heights Call”的服务，能够回应住户的请求……

[译自[url=http://wata-ame.zombie.jp/kandelaar/]官方网站[/url]]
